summary: 💡 **QuanDupeLightsources** no longer installs NoSmokeStayLit and QuanPieces automatically; install them yourself if you want their light duplicates.

bullets: NoSmokeStayLit and QuanPieces are no longer required dependencies, so install them yourself; the mod still loads after them when present.
Vanilla duplicates are always added, and street light duplicates are added whenever QuanPieces is installed.
